svg.title: Asking UniProt: a job with a ticket number
svg.desc: Step 1 posts the identifiers to /idmapping/run and gets a job number, which is kept. Step 2 asks /idmapping/status without following redirects until the answer is HTTP 303 FINISHED; these answers are not kept. Step 3 downloads the results table, which is kept; an identifier with no row did not map.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Like a busy cafe counter: hand in the order, take a number, ask if it's ready, collect.
